positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
ImpacT Project for Professor Dale Musser PhD.
ImpacT helps students develop an understanding of the world, society, and self through authentic data in open datasets while learning IT topics such as programming, databases, web services, and data analytics. Students engage with social sciences topics through authentic, real world, impactful data used in activities, challenges, projects, assessments, and learning materials in information technology topics. The datasets, APIs, and sample code provided by ImpacT are defined to meet the needs of learners at different learning stages from beginner through expert and to address a broad range of social science topics.

projects.title: PixelSmash
projects.description: Web Application, browser based game styled as a pixelated fighting game similar to Nintendo's Super Smash Bros.  Developed with React, Node.js, MySQL, and Phazer.

projects.title: Reynolds's Journalism Institute Image Classifier
projects.description: Our project is a machine learning ranking system that takes user-uploaded images and gives them a quality score. Meant to help journalists be able to quickly identify their photos with the best composition.  Then, the user is allowed to view and sort the images they've uploaded, and select any or all photos that they'd like to re-download.
